śila, m. ear of corn left on the field: 🞄gleaning ears of corn;
 N. of a son of Pāriyātra.
śilā́, f. stone, rock, crag.
śila‿āhārin, a. gleaning ears of 🞄corn.
śilikā-koṣṭha, m. N. of a 🞄mountain village.

śilīṃdhra, n. flower of the plantain 🞄tree (Musa sapientum);
 mushroom.
śilī-bhūta, pp. turned to stone, 🞄become as hard as stone.
śilā‿uccaya, m. (pile of rock), 🞄mountain.

śila‿uñcha, m. gleaning of ears of 🞄corn;
 m. du. or n. sg. gleaning of ears and 🞄picking up grains.
1. śilpá, a. variegated (YV.).
śilpa‿upajīvin, m. artist, 🞄craftsman.

śīlana, n. exercise, practice, study, 🞄cultivation, of (—˚);
 frequent mention.
sillana, m. N..

śīl-in, a. honourable, moral (preson);
 🞄—˚ (= śīla) habituated to, practising, etc..
silla-rāja, m. N..
